changes.comment: sdk-ui-kit: Split UiButton's shared badge margin override into separate __badge-number and __badge-text modifiers so text badges (e.g. the reasoning effort badge in the AI assistant agent dropdown) can be spaced 10px from the label instead of inheriting the 2.5px pull-in tuned for parenthesised numeric badges. They previously sat 2.5px apart, which was hard to distinguish, especially with high-contrast theming where the color difference between them is replaced by a single system color.
